concept_gloss.applicability: Söz biçiminin türemiş anlamlarını değil, kaynaklarda doğrudan ad olarak kaydedilen kullanımlarını topluca gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: İki yer adı ile özel söz öbeğindeki kişi adı ayrımını korur.

concept_map.definition: Aynı söz biçiminin yer adı olarak kullanılan iki kaydını ve bir anlatıda kişi adı olarak geçen özel bir söz öbeğini kapsayan adlandırma dalıdır.

facets.statement: Tek sözcüklü iki kullanım belirli yerleri adlandırır.
Özel söz öbeği, anlatıda geçen bir kişiyi adlandırır ve yer adı kullanımlarından ayrıdır.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal bir kolaylık, yön veya varlıklılık anlamı değil, yer ve kişi adlarının toplu kaydıdır.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi iki yer adı kullanımı ile bir kişinin adı olarak geçen söz öbeğini açıkça sıralar. Dal, bunları türemiş bir ortak anlam gibi açıklamadan adlandırma kullanımları olarak tuttuğu sürece kaynağa uygundur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, tek sözcüklü yer adlarını kişi adı içeren özel söz öbeğinden ayırır ve hiçbirinden genel bir yalın anlam türetmez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adlandırma dalları değerlendirildi; yalnız yer adı içeren dal ile yer ve kişi adlarını birlikte içeren dal, bu kaydın kapsamını en iyi karşılaştırır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yer adlarını bir kişi adı kullanımıyla birlikte toplar; komşu dal ise kendi biçimlerinin yalnızca yer adı oluşlarını kaydeder.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İki yer adının yanında özel bir söz öbeğinde kişi adı kullanımı da vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Yalnızca kendi söz biçimlerinden aktarılan yer adlarını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da sözlükte türemiş anlam olarak değil, doğrudan ad olarak kaydedilmiş yerleri içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Anlam türleri benzer olsa da adlandırılan varlıklar ve onları taşıyan söz biçimleri ayrıdır; bu nedenle sözlüksel yerine geçme yoktur.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Aynı söz biçimine bağlı iki yer ve bir kişi adı kaydı vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: yer, su kaynağı ve kişi adları
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kendi söz biçiminden aktarılan yer, su kaynağı ve kişi adı kayıtları bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da sıradan söz biçimlerinin özel ad olarak kullanılmasını kaydeder.

branches.source_phrase_ar: يسر: مكان (maqayis)؛ اليسر أيضا: دخل لنبى يربوع بالدهناء (sihah)؛ يسار الكواعب هو اسم عبد (sihah)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak ifadesi, aynı söz biçiminin iki ayrı yer adı kullanımını ve özel bir söz öbeğinin kişi adı kullanımını herhangi bir türetme bağı kurmadan bir araya getirir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه يسر أو اليسر اسما لمكان، ويسار علما لشخص في شاهد شعري.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هذا معنى اشتقاقيا كالسهولة أو اليسار أو الميسر.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yaşı genç olan erkek kişiyi adlandıran yalın kullanım için doğrudan ve eksiksiz karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin erkek ve genç olması koşullarını birlikte korur.

concept_map.definition: Genç yaştaki erkek, başka bir deyişle delikanlıdır.

facets.statement: Yalın biçim genç yaştaki bir erkeği adlandırır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Genç erkekten doğal ve tek sözcüklü biçimde söz edilen genel bağlamlarda kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Genç erkek anlamını doğal bir kişi adıyla eksiksiz korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam genç erkekle sınırlıdır; varlıklılık, sol yön ve kişi adı kullanımları bu dala girmez.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalın biçimi doğrudan genç erkek anlamında verir. Dal çerçevesi bu tek tanıklığı varlıklılık veya sol yön anlamlarına taşımadan bağımsız bir insan nitelemesi olarak doğru biçimde korur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca yalın biçimin genç erkek anlamını verir ve başka yapılara ya da eş biçimli dallara genişletilmez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün gençlik ve kişi nitelemesi adayları incelendi; genel gençlik dalı ile ek canlılık ve beceri taşıyan genç erkek dalı en yararlı sınırları sağladı.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yalnızca genç erkeği adlandırır; komşu dal gençliği insan dışındaki yenilik, tazelik ve yakın zaman anlamlarına da genişletir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Doğrudan genç bir erkek kişiyi adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Gençlik yanında yenilik, tazelik ve yakın zamanda ortaya çıkma niteliklerini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir erkeğin genç yaşta bulunmasını anlatabilir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yaş ve cinsiyetle sınırlıdır; komşu dal genç erkeğe canlılık, kavrayış ve beceri gibi ayırt edici özellikler ekler.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Genç erkek olmak dışında bir davranış veya beceri koşulu taşımaz.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Canlı, kavrayışlı, becerikli ve neşeli olma gibi ek nitelikler gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da genç yaştaki erkek kişiyi adlandırır.

source_note.MQ: Tek tanıklık, yalın söz biçimini doğrudan genç yaştaki erkek anlamında kaydeder.

branches.source_phrase_ar: اليسار: الفتى (maqayis)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Genç erkek anlamı tek kaynak tanıklığıyla verilir ve başka bir yaş, yön veya varlıklılık anlamıyla desteklenmez.

source_details.summary: Tek tanıklık, yalın söz biçimini doğrudan genç yaştaki erkek anlamında kaydeder.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه اليسار بمعنى الفتى كما أفرده ابن فارس.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو اليسار بمعنى الغنى ولا اليسار خلاف اليمين.

root_profile.summary: Kök, kolaylık ve hazır oluş çevresindeki merkezden azlık, maddi bolluk, sol yön, uyumlu hareket, hayvancılık, tarihsel talih oyunu, beden izleri ve teknik yönelimlere uzanan çok dallı bir anlam yapısı taşır. Yer ve kişi adları ile genç erkek anlamı daha bağımsız uçlarda yer alır.

text.arabic_uthmani: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا ٱلْخَمْرُ وَٱلْمَيْسِرُ وَٱلْأَنصَابُ وَٱلْأَزْلَٰمُ رِجْسٌۭ مِّنْ عَمَلِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ فَٱجْتَنِبُوهُ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ

baseline.text: Ey inananlar! Sarhoş edici içki, kumar, dikili taşlar ve fal okları ancak şeytanın işinden birer pisliktir. Bunlardan kaçının ki kurtuluşa eresiniz.

findings.text: İçki, kumar ve kirli uygulamaların kolaylık görüntüsü, insanın eylem gücünü örter ve dolaştırır.
Kurtuluş, bu uygulamalarla araya yanlamasına bir mesafe koyup verimli alanı yeniden işlemeyi gerektirir.

activation_trace.role: Covering and concealment supply the system's impairment of perception.
Gambling by lots and partition of a slaughtered camel supply its chance-allocation mechanism.
An erected stone for worship or slaughter supplies a material focal point for the system.
Confusion and entanglement make rijs the system's cognitive and practical output.
Employing an instrument makes the named things components activated by use.
Opposition, crookedness, and deviation characterize the direction produced by that work.
Active distancing and withdrawal supply the required system-level response.

changed_reading.after: Four components form one intentionally operated social and epistemic system; its product is confusion and crooked distance, so the command exits the whole configuration.
changed_reading.before: Four independently forbidden objects are called filthy and must be avoided.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The four-item list is singularized as rijs from an intentional work and met by the spatial command fajtanibuhu.
baseline_models.mechanism: Covering judgment, chance-partition, erected sacrificial authority, and decision by arrows operate as one coupled practice-system. Its rijs is not inert dirt alone: intentional use turns the parts into confusion and crooked distance, so avoidance means leaving the operating system rather than merely disliking four objects.

activation_trace.role: Ease after difficulty supplies the shortcut's attractive promise.
Wealth and abundance supply the promised payoff of the shortcut.
Gambling and lot-based division show how the promised ease is operationalized.
Cutting and opening supply the laboring action beneath flourishing.
The farmer who opens soil supplies a cultivated rather than accidental gain model.
Victory with enduring good supplies the long-horizon result.

changed_reading.after: Reject the seductive economy of easy, lucky gain so that success can instead be cut open, cultivated, and made durable.
changed_reading.before: Avoid gambling so that success may follow.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Al-maysir stands inside the rejected list while tuflihun states the promised result.
baseline_models.mechanism: Maysir offers ease, wealth, and gain by lots; falah also names cutting open and cultivating soil before it names lasting success. The verse opposes shortcut acquisition to worked, durable flourishing: one leaves the easy-gain apparatus in order to open and cultivate a viable future.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the obscured field in which the apparatus claims to decide.
An erected boundary marker supplies externally fixed orientation.
A fixed origin or threshold supplies the apparatus's claim to measure.
Confusion and entanglement identify the actual epistemic result.
Instrument-use makes false orientation a manufactured practice rather than a passive mistake.

changed_reading.after: The list exposes an operated apparatus that first obscures reality and then claims to resolve it through erected signs, measures, and arrows.
changed_reading.before: Divining arrows are one prohibited ritual item among several.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Khamr, ansab, azlam, rijs, and amal combine concealment, markers, decision devices, confusion, and instrument-use.
baseline_models.mechanism: The cluster can be read as a false uncertainty-management apparatus: it covers what is seen, erects signs and fixed measures, then uses arrows to manufacture a decision. The result is not knowledge but entanglement, while amal marks the apparatus as something people actively operate.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate withdrawal supplies a bounded spatial response.
Prohibition and prevention mark the overreach explicitly rejected before the focus.
Wholesomeness opposed to foulness preserves a positive field outside the named perimeter.
Release of a restriction prevents avoidance from expanding into self-made prohibition.
Placing oneself in protection supplies the governing posture for discriminating consumption.

changed_reading.after: Avoidance is a targeted act of discrimination that protects lawful, wholesome life from both the named harms and overprohibition.
changed_reading.before: Avoidance is a broad holiness strategy of withdrawing from suspect pleasures.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding frame forbids making wholesome things unlawful, commands lawful wholesome consumption, and calls for protective awareness. That frame turns ijtinab into a precise perimeter around the named configuration, not a generalized ascetic recoil from enjoyment or matter.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a positive lawful field and a named negative list; I infer that ijtinab draws a discriminating boundary between them. The live alternative is that the preceding commands merely balance, rather than define, the focus command.
structural_cues: 5:87-88 place anti-overprohibition and lawful wholesome eating immediately before the focus list.

activation_trace.role: Gambling lots and partition of a slaughtered animal supply the rejected allocation procedure.
Sacrificial stones connect the rejected allocation to a ritualized slaughter setting.
A deliberately bound obligation supplies accountable causation for the remedy.
Covering or effacing an offense supplies the reparative aim.
Feeding another redirects material distribution toward need.
A just and choice middle supplies a calibrated household standard.
Freedom opposed to bondage makes liberation one concrete distributive repair.

changed_reading.after: It also clears space for accountable distribution: obligation is repaired by measured provision and release rather than luck, extraction, and ritualized shares.
changed_reading.before: The verse only removes gambling and altar sacrifice.

context_deltas.mechanism: The oath procedure replaces lot-based extraction and sacrificial division with deliberate, measured repair: a binding act incurs a covering remedy distributed as food from a household's middle standard, clothing, liberation, or fasting. The contrast supplies a constructive economy for what avoidance leaves behind.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies random sacrificial partition in the maysir branch and calibrated feeding or freeing in the oath sequence; I infer a replacement social economy. The live alternative is that oath expiation is locally procedural without intentionally answering maysir.
structural_cues: 5:89 specifies quantities, recipients, a middle standard, and ordered alternatives rather than a chance outcome.

activation_trace.role: Distance and severance identify the work's directional tendency.
Voluntary withdrawal supplies the counter-distance.
Falling and becoming fixed supply the insertion of hostility into communal life.
The connection standing between endpoints supplies the relation being damaged.
Enmity names the social separation produced.
Turning away and obstruction supply the devotional blocking action.
Recovering what is held against forgetting names one blocked capacity.
The specified worship names the other blocked practice.
Arrival at an endpoint turns avoidance into actual cessation.

changed_reading.after: Take deliberate distance from a separator: the practices lodge hostility between people and obstruct the recurrent acts that reconnect attention and worship.
changed_reading.before: Keep away because the objects are impure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah opens the focus's compressed causal chain: the shaytan-work makes hostility fall and settle inside the relation between people, then turns them away from remembrance and prayer. Chosen distance from the practices prevents the practices from manufacturing social and devotional distance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shaytan as distance, ijtinab as chosen distance, and explicit social and devotional obstruction; I infer a reversal in which one separation prevents another. The alternative is a simpler causal list without spatial counter-patterning.
structural_cues: 5:91 repeats khamr and maysir, states two effects, and ends by asking whether the addressees will stop.

activation_trace.role: Polluting filth supplies the reading that context must qualify.
Intentional action places the focus on practiced agency.
Repeated intentional good work supplies the contrasting action trajectory.
Soundness opposed to corruption qualifies the work that now governs the trajectory.
Inclination toward guilt supplies the burden explicitly negated.
Repeated self-protection supplies an ongoing rather than retroactive moral orientation.

changed_reading.after: The warning targets an operated pattern whose present direction can be left; prior tasting is not made into an irreversible identity when the enacted trajectory changes.
changed_reading.before: Contact or consumption permanently contaminates the person.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus calls the cluster rijs from work, and 5:93 answers prior tasting with no guilt while repeating protective awareness, faith, good work, and excellence. This shifts emphasis from irreversible material staining to the direction and quality of an enacted trajectory.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies past tasting without guilt and present repeated good action; I infer that rijs is chiefly the active configuration and trajectory, not an indelible stain from contact. The alternative is a narrower temporal exemption that leaves the ontology of rijs unchanged.
structural_cues: 5:93 negates guilt regarding what was tasted and repeats taqwa, faith, and good action in a staged sequence.

activation_trace.role: Erecting something visibly supplies the broad material image that cannot alone explain condemnation.
An erected worship or slaughter stone specifies the rejected ritual function.
A protected sacred space supplies a positively ordered ritual boundary.
Support and means of livelihood state the public function of the authorized forms.
An offering directed to the sanctuary supplies a non-condemned sacrificial form.
A neck-marker or ornament supplies a positively used visible ritual sign.

changed_reading.after: The rejected object belongs to a harmful authority-and-slaughter system; authorized markers can instead uphold communal order, so material form alone is not the criterion.
changed_reading.before: Erected ritual objects and sacrificial markers are intrinsically polluting.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's erected sacrificial stones are followed by a sacred house, sacred time, offerings, and marked collars made a support for people. Material erection and ritual marking therefore do not produce rijs by themselves; function and authorization distinguish an exploitative altar-system from forms that stabilize public life.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a negative erected altar and positive sacred materials with a stated public function; I infer a functional and provenance distinction. The alternative is that the positive list is legally separate and does not semantically qualify ansab.
structural_cues: 5:97 coordinates house, sacred month, offerings, and collars and assigns them the function qiyaman lil-nas.

activation_trace.role: Wealth and abundance supply the alluring quantitative promise.
Polluting foulness supplies the quality concealed by that promise.
Inferior foulness opposed to wholesomeness supplies the qualitative criterion.
Beauty in the eye supplies the perceptual seduction of abundance.
Growth in number supplies scale without goodness.
Self-protection supplies resistance to the impressive display.
Enduring success explicitly closes the qualitative discrimination.

changed_reading.after: Falah is a trained refusal to confuse impressive quantity and easy wealth with wholesome, durable value.
changed_reading.before: Falah is the favorable outcome obtained after obeying a ban.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later recurrence of falah denies equality between foul and wholesome even when foul abundance impresses. This exposes the maysir promise of ease and wealth as a quantitative counterfeit: flourishing requires protected discrimination by the inner core, not maximization of winnings or volume.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies maysir's wealth image and a later warning that impressive quantity can remain foul; I infer a counterfeit-falah mechanism. The alternative is that 5:100 gives a general maxim without special reference to gambling's gain structure.
structural_cues: The branchless focus on ulul-albab in 5:100 locates discrimination in the perceiving core rather than the visible count.

activation_trace.role: A sounding stone that estimates depth while stirring a well supplies a material image of intrusive measurement.
Requesting and asking supply the drive to extract an answer.
Emergence into visibility supplies the demanded disclosure.
What causes distress supplies the cost of disclosure.
Returning speech and answering supply the response whose content is not claimed.
Disclosure to a knower marks the knowledge explicitly disclaimed and ultimately located.
Concealment from sight supplies the domain that the false apparatus claims to penetrate.

changed_reading.after: They exemplify a recurring epistemic vice: forcing uncertainty into an actionable answer when truthful restraint should leave the hidden unclaimed.
changed_reading.before: Divining arrows are rejected as an obsolete ritual technique.

context_deltas.mechanism: The warning against questions whose disclosure harms, followed later by a scene in which respondents disclaim knowledge before the knower of hidden things, activates azlam as an answer-extraction device. The focus then rejects not inquiry itself but engineered certainty that forces the hidden into an actionable sign.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a divining-arrow surface, harmful demanded disclosure, and disciplined non-claiming before the unseen; I infer a critique of forced epistemic closure. The live alternative is that 5:101 concerns needless questions generally and 5:109 concerns accountability without a link to azlam.
structural_cues: The branchless focus term azlam is a decision-sign within the four-item list.
5:101 links questioning, disclosure, and harm; 5:109 explicitly withholds a claimed answer before knowledge of the unseen.

activation_trace.role: Making something stand visibly supplies the institutional erection of a rule or authority.
Putting a device to work supplies the humanly operated production mechanism.
Crooked opposition supplies the direction of the fabricated norm.
Making a thing into a designated state supplies institutional classification.
The specific inherited animal category supplies a concrete fabricated ritual taxonomy.
Fabricating a lie supplies false attribution to divine authority.
Reason that restrains ignorance supplies the absent corrective.
Finding something already present supplies inherited social fact as the claimed warrant.
Ancestral parentage supplies transmission and prestige without proof.
Gentle indication toward truth supplies the guidance the inherited system lacks.

changed_reading.after: It can also be institutional: people manufacture classifications, erect them as sacred authority, and preserve them through inherited prestige despite absent knowledge.
changed_reading.before: The shaytan-work consists mainly of personal indulgence and superstition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The animal classifications in 5:103 are humanly made, fabricated as a lie about God, and defended in 5:104 by inherited finding without knowledge or guidance. That sequence expands shaytan's work from private temptation into an institutional production line that erects arbitrary divisions as sacred authority.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a focus list of operated ritual devices and a later list of fabricated inherited classifications; I infer a shared mechanism of arbitrary divisions made sacred. The alternative is that the two lists attack distinct practices without inviting a systems-level analogy.
structural_cues: 5:103 lists four animal-rule labels, denies their divine institution, and 5:104 immediately stages an appeal to ancestral precedent.

activation_trace.role: Lots and gambling supply an opaque chance procedure for allocating an outcome.
Entangled uncertainty supplies the condition a decision procedure must honestly handle.
Declaration grounded in knowledge supplies accountable evidence.
Justice in judgment qualifies the witnesses and procedure.
A sworn undertaking distributes responsibility onto named speakers.
Agitated doubt is admitted rather than concealed by false certainty.
Discovery of what was hidden supplies investigation and error detection.
Making truth manifest supplies the corrective aim.
Rejecting a false or defective claim supplies reversibility.
Hearing as understanding and compliance closes the public procedure.

changed_reading.after: They are also anti-procedures: opaque chance and anonymous signs are replaced by named, just, reviewable testimony that can expose and correct error.
changed_reading.before: Maysir and azlam are forbidden forms of play and omen-taking.

context_deltas.mechanism: The witness sequence resolves uncertainty through present testimony, justice, sworn accountability, investigation of concealed wrongdoing, replacement witnesses, and reversible oaths. It supplies a transparent and corrigible decision procedure in place of the opaque allocation and answer produced by maysir and azlam.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies chance lots in maysir and a later contestable evidence protocol; I infer that avoidance rejects unaccountable decision technology, not decision under uncertainty itself. The alternative is that inheritance testimony and gambling answer unrelated legal domains.
structural_cues: 5:106-108 forms a multi-stage procedure with two witnesses, oath, challenge, replacement, and return of oaths.
The branchless azlam in the focus supplies the contrasting decision device.

activation_trace.role: Intoxicating drink supplies one consumption practice in the destabilizing setting.
Gambling shares of a slaughtered animal supply its divisive distribution practice.
A tray or table bearing food supplies the rival communal setting.
Self-protection bounds the table request before gratification.
Eating names legitimate shared consumption rather than intoxication.
Stillness and reassurance supply the table's intended affective result.
The heart supplies the site stabilized rather than covered or agitated.
Truthful speech supplies confirmation rather than divinatory guesswork.
The repeated table image makes the communal material center explicit.
Apportioned gift supplies provision without gambling extraction.

changed_reading.after: It rejects a table-order that covers judgment and divides participants, while the wider packet imagines shared provision capable of settling hearts under truth and accountability.
changed_reading.before: The focus bans several pleasures and rituals associated with consumption.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus cluster evokes a consuming and distributing social setting organized by intoxicant, gambling shares, slaughter stones, and arrows. The later table sequence offers a rival architecture: a shared table for eating, provision, truthful confirmation, and still hearts, bounded by taqwa and heightened accountability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies drink, gambling shares, and slaughter in the focus and a bounded shared table later; I infer competing table economies. The live alternative is that the table episode is an independent sign narrative whose food imagery is only analogically related.
structural_cues: 5:112-115 moves from a table request through eating, heart-settling, truth-confirmation, provision, warning, and accountability.

activation_trace.role: Wealth and ease supply the immediate gain that needs revaluation.
Success as victory and remaining in good supplies the focus's open endpoint.
Benefit opposed to harm supplies the criterion for real gain.
Truth realized in promise and action makes benefit dependable.
Persistence resistant to decay supplies durability.
Victory as good and rescue confirms the long-horizon result.
Sovereign dominion limits the gambler's fantasy of acquired control.
Effective capacity to bring about action limits the diviner's simulated mastery.

changed_reading.after: Falah is durable, truth-bearing benefit under real sovereignty, the opposite of transient lucky wealth and simulated control over outcomes.
changed_reading.before: Falah is an unspecified reward for abstention.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing movement joins useful truth, fulfilled truthfulness, permanence, and victory, then locates dominion and effective capacity beyond human control. This gives falah a long horizon opposed to maysir's easy wealth and azlam's simulated control: real gain is truthful benefit that lasts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies falah in the focus and a closing cluster of truthful benefit, durability, victory, dominion, and capacity; I infer that the close fills out falah against lucky gain and manufactured control. The alternative is that the close states a general eschatological outcome without lexical feedback into 5:90.
structural_cues: 5:119 names benefit, truth, permanence, and great victory in one result sequence; 5:120 closes with dominion and capacity.

remaining_uncertainties: The competing-table reading is a strong cross-pericope analogy but may not be an intended direct contrast.
It remains uncertain how far rijs names the assembled operation rather than qualifying each listed item independently.
Azlam has no focus branch inventory, so its epistemic activations rely on the focus surface and branch-backed context rather than a citable focus branch.
The tether, sounding-well, and sales-trick images are lexical resonances and should not be promoted into direct denotations.
strongest_changes: The four items became one operated social and epistemic system rather than four isolated dirty objects.
Chosen distance in 5:90 became the countermeasure to the social and devotional distance explicitly produced in 5:91.
Lawful consumption and positive sacred markers forced a functional and provenance-based distinction instead of blanket material taboo.
Measured restitution, corrigible testimony, and truthful shared provision emerged as constructive replacements for chance allocation and forced signs.
Falah shifted from generic reward or easy gain to discriminating, truthful benefit that endures.
summary.what_was_special: Across the packet, the focus list was repeatedly reactivated by paired contrasts: lawful and harmful consumption, authorized and fabricated ritual signs, opaque and accountable uncertainty procedures, destabilizing and heart-settling tables, and transient gain versus durable truthful benefit.

activation_trace.role: Enslavement or coercive possession supplies capture of the participant.
A long tightly twisted rope used to draw or tether supplies the leash image.
Employing a thing supplies the participant's apparent control of the apparatus.
Leading an animal or captive at one's side reverses who is actually directing whom.

changed_reading.after: The operated objects can become a tethering apparatus that recruits, owns, and leads the apparent operator.
changed_reading.before: A person freely uses several dangerous objects.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The image is surprising because it combines distant material branches: enslavement, a long tether, and leading something at one's side. It remains anchored in khamr, shaytan, amal, and ijtinab, but downstream prose should present it as a diagnostic metaphor for captured agency, not as the direct lexical definition of the named practices.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The user of the practices may appear to operate them while khamr, shaytan, amal, and ijtinab carry counter-images of ownership, tethering, employment, and being led.

activation_trace.role: The sounding stone both disturbs sediment and gauges depth, modeling knowledge produced through disturbance.
Covering supplies the obscurity the gauge purports to overcome.
An erected marker supplies the external sign used to orient or measure.

changed_reading.after: Rijs can also image a muddy depth-gauge: the practice disturbs and obscures reality, then mistakes the resulting signal for reliable knowledge.
changed_reading.before: Rijs simply labels the cluster as repellent filth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The sounding-stone branch is materially remote and therefore cannot define rijs here. It remains worth carrying because it is directly anchored in the focus root and coheres with covering, markers, azlam, and confusion; prose should mark it as an exploratory image of an apparatus that muddies what it claims to measure.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Rijs includes the branch image of a stone dropped into a well to stir sediment or estimate depth by sound.

activation_trace.role: Embellishing a sale, deception, and inducing a bid supply a counterfeit marketing of success.
Gambling supplies the product that sells chance as gain.
Appearing beautiful to the eye supplies the sales display.
Numerical abundance supplies the impressive advertised payoff.
Truth fulfilled in action supplies the packet's final contrast to deceptive success-talk.

changed_reading.after: The promise may polemically take back the word of flourishing from an apparatus that decorates, advertises, and sells lucky gain as though it were success.
changed_reading.before: The verse promises success after a straightforward prohibition.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a distant falah branch concerns embellishing a sale and deceptive inducement, while the surface here plainly promises success. The shared root, maysir's gain structure, later impressive abundance, and final truthful benefit keep the resonance anchored; prose should render it as polemical wordplay, never replace the ordinary success sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Tuflihun may reclaim the language of success from practices that market easy gain.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Apparent ease veils and entangles agency.** `خ م ر B001` is covering, `ي س ر B001` ready ease, `ر ج س B005` confused entanglement, and `ش ط ن B001` remoteness. I infer that intoxicant and gambling market easy access while covering judgment and moving the agent farther from sound relation.
2. **Success requires lateral distance before cultivation.** `ج ن ب B003` is keeping aside and `ف ل ح B003` tilling split ground. I infer that avoidance clears the field in which lasting good can be cultivated; management within the entanglement is not the proposed mechanism.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later ayah 5:120 made the fixed ayah's local distinctions newly visible as bounded operations within a single encompassing dominion, rather than as an isolated rule or episode.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **An apparent opening veils and entangles.** Fixed **خ م ر / B001** (“covering and veiling”) supplies intoxication’s cognitive action, while fixed **ي س ر / B001** (“ease and ready opening”) shadows gambling’s apparent accessibility. Fixed **ر ج س / B005** (“confused entanglement”) names their combined state. 5:87–5:89 carefully opened goods and repaired bindings; 5:91 shows these practices instead producing hostility and obstruction. I infer that promised ease recruits the user into a system that covers judgment and tangles relations. Avoidance reads as spatial refusal to enter that mechanism.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 5:91 explicitly disclosed the mechanism only announced here: veiled and apparently easy practices land hostility between people and turn attention away from prayer.

words.gloss_range: vocative particle opening a direct summons
words.prose: {{ar:يَا}} ({{tr:yā}}) opens the ayah as a summons before any prohibited item is named. The prohibition is therefore not an abstract notice; it is delivered to a present community that must listen before the verdict and command unfold.

topics.headline: opening summons scopes the ruling
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah first creates an addressed listening situation before naming any prohibited object.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on the vocative particle as the address frame for the full prohibition sequence.
